author: nickyeow

english.text: How can I afford such an expensive car?

jyutping: gaa3 ce1 gam3 gwai3，ngo5 dim2 maai5 dak1 hei2 aa3？
text: 架車咁貴，我點買得起呀？

author: nickyeow

english.text: In a dictionary like this one there should be at least two sentences with "fridge".

jyutping: gam2 ge3 zi6 din2 zi3 siu2 dou1 jing1 goi1 jau5 loeng5 geoi3「syut3 gwai6」ge3 lai6 geoi3 gwaa3。
text: 噉嘅字典至少都應該有兩句「雪櫃」嘅例句啩。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Why didn't you come?

jyutping: nei5 zou6 me1 mou4 lai4 dou3 ge3？
text: 你做咩無嚟到嘅？

author: nickyeow

english.text: Three more passengers got on the bus.

jyutping: gan1 zyu6 jau6 jau5 saam1 go3 jan4 soeng5 zo2 gaa3 baa1 si2。
text: 跟住又有三個人上咗架巴士。

author: nickyeow

english.text: What the hell are you doing?

jyutping: nei5 hai2 dou6 zou6 mat1 lan2 je5 aa3？
text: 你喺度做乜撚嘢呀？

author: nickyeow

english.text: It will make little difference whether you go there by taxi or on foot.

jyutping: nei5 daap3 dik1 si2 heoi3 tung4 hang4 lou6 heoi3 dou1 mou4 me1 fan1 bit6。
text: 你搭的士去同行路去都無咩分別。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Mind your head.

jyutping: jan1 zyu6 zong6 tau4。
text: 因住撞頭。

author: nickyeow

english.text: You can't be hungry. You've just had dinner.

jyutping: nei5 ngaam1 ngaam1 sin1 sik6 jyun4 maan5 caan1，mou4 lei5 jau4 gam3 faai3 zau6 tou5 ngo6 go2 wo3。
text: 你啱啱先食完晚餐，無理由咁快就肚餓嗰喎。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Oh, now I understand.

jyutping: o5，ngo5 ji4 gaa1 ming4 laa3。
text: 哦，我而家明喇。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Who can tell me how a light bulb works?

jyutping: jau5 mou5 jan4 ho2 ji5 waa6 ngo5 teng1 din6 dang1 daam2 ge3 jyun4 lei5 hai6 dim2 gaa3？
text: 有冇人可以話我聽電燈膽嘅原理係點㗎？

author: nickyeow

english.text: Where is your father?

jyutping: nei5 aa3 baa4 hai2 bin1 aa3？
text: 你阿爸喺邊呀？

author: nickyeow

english.text: She has left her umbrella behind.

jyutping: keoi5 lau6 dai1 zo2 keoi5 baa2 ze1。
text: 佢漏低咗佢把遮。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Our school encourages sports.

jyutping: ngo5 dei6 hok6 haau6 hou2 gu2 lai6 di1 tung4 hok6 zou6 wan6 dung6。
text: 我哋學校好鼓勵啲同學做運動。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I'm right.

jyutping: ngo5 hai6 ngaam1 ge3。
text: 我係啱嘅。

author: fercheung

english.text: What a shame!

jyutping: zan1 hai6 ho2 sik1！
text: 真係可惜！

author: kaenif

english.text: Wait for the green signal before starting to cross.

jyutping: dang2 dou3 luk6 dang1 sin1 hou2 gwo3 maa5 lou6 aa3。
text: 等到綠燈先好過馬路呀。

author: kaenif

english.text: I don't use taxis unless it's absolutely necessary.

jyutping: jyu4 fei1 bit1 jiu3 ngo5 dou1 m4 wui5 daap3 dik1 si2。
text: 如非必要我都唔會搭的士。

author: kaenif

english.text: I may be unsociable, but it doesn't mean I don't talk to people.

jyutping: ngo5 ho2 nang4 se5 gaau1 m4 hai6 hou2 hou2，daan6 hai6 m4 doi6 biu2 ngo5 m4 tung4 jan4 gong2 je5。
text: 我可能社交唔係好好，但係唔代表我唔同人講嘢。

author: kaenif

english.text: He has made the same mistake twice.

jyutping: taa1 faan6 zo2 loeng5 ci3 soeng1 tung4 ge3 co3 ng6。
text: 他犯咗兩次相同嘅錯誤。

author: kaenif

english.text: The quiz competition was a piece of cake.

jyutping: go3 man6 daap3 bei2 coi3 gaan2 zik6 ji6 gwo3 ze3 fo2。
text: 個問答比賽簡直易過借火。

author: nickyeow

english.text: May I have a glass of beer, please?

jyutping: jat1 bui1 be1 zau2 aa1 m4 goi1。
text: 一杯啤酒吖唔該。

author: nickyeow

english.text: That doll is scary.

jyutping: go2 go3 gung1 zai2 hou2 hung2 bou3。
text: 嗰個公仔好恐怖。

author: nickyeow

english.text: If you want to take a break, just say so.

jyutping: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 soeng2 dau2 haa5 zau6 ceot1 seng1 laa1。
text: 如果你想抖吓就出聲啦。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Don't you feel hungry?

jyutping: nei5 m4 tou5 ngo6 ge3 me1？
text: 你唔肚餓嘅咩？

author: nickyeow

english.text: Tom is able to swim well.

jyutping: aa3 Tom jau4 seoi2 hou2 ging6。
text: 阿Tom游水好勁。

author: nickyeow

english.text: The witness says that the vandal was around 18 years old.

jyutping: zing3 jan4 waa2 go2 go3 po3 waai6 gung1 mat6 ge3 jan4 daai6 joek3 sap6 baat3 seoi3。
text: 證人話嗰個破壞公物嘅人大約十八歲。

author: AlbadeG

english.text: I don't like watching TV.

jyutping: ngo5 m4 zung1 ji3 tai2 din6 si6。
text: 我唔中意睇电视。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Why isn't Sami coming?

jyutping: dim2 gaai2 sam1 mei5 m4 lai4 ge3？
text: 點解森美唔嚟嘅？

author: nickyeow

english.text: Intelligent people are often arrogant.

jyutping: di1 lek1 ge3 jan4 tung1 soeng4 dou1 hou2 zi6 daai6。
text: 啲叻嘅人通常都好自大。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Tom looked around, but didn't see anyone.

jyutping: aa3 Tom zau1 wai4 mong6，daan6 hai6 gin3 m4 dou2 jau5 jan4。
text: 阿Tom周圍望，但係見唔到有人。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I liked walking alone on the deserted beach.

jyutping: ngo5 go2 zan6 hou3 zung1 ji3 zi6 gei2 jat1 go3 hai2 go3 mou5 jan4 ge3 saa1 taan1 dou3 saan3 bou6。
text: 我嗰陣好鍾意自己一個喺個冇人嘅沙灘到散步。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: The franchise of Star Trek is quintessential in science fiction. I grew up with the show, as a child in the Philippines to a child in North America. The franchise is real adventure and exploration. Visiting Italy, in the hotel room, I saw Star Trek: The Next Generation dubbed in Italian. Since then, I have watched various series of the Star Trek franchise in French and Spanish, besides in the original English.

jyutping: 《sing1 zai3 mai4 hong4》ge3 dak6 heoi2 ging1 jing4 kyun4 hai6 fo1 waan6 siu2 syut3 ge3 gik6 ban2。ngo5 hai6 ceoi4 zyu6 ni1 go3 zit3 muk6 ji4 zoeng2 daai6，jau4 fei1 leot6 ban1 ge3 sai3 lou6 dou3 bak1 mei5 ge3 sai3 lou6。ni1 go3 dak6 heoi2 ging1 jing4 kyun4 hai6 zan1 zing3 ge3 mou6 him2 tung4 taam3 sok3。heoi3 dou3 ji3 daai6 lei6，hai2 zau2 dim3 fong4 jap6 min6，ngo5 gin3 dou3 jung6 ji3 daai6 lei6 man4 pui3 jam1 ge3《sing1 zai3 mai4 hong4：haa6 jat1 doi6》。zi6 ci2 zi1 hau6，ceoi4 zo2 jung6 jing1 man2 jyun4 baan2 zi1 ngoi6，ngo5 zung6 jung6 faat3 man4 tung4 sai1 baan1 ngaa4 man4 tai2 zo2 m4 tung4 ge3 sing1 zai3 mai4 hong4 hai6 lit6 kek6 zaap6。
text: 《星際迷航》嘅特許經營權係科幻小說嘅極品。我係隨住呢個節目而長大，由菲律賓嘅細路到北美嘅細路。呢個特許經營權係真正嘅冒險同探索。去到意大利，喺酒店房入面，我見到用意大利文配音嘅《星際迷航：下一代》。自此之後，除咗用英文原版之外，我仲用法文同西班牙文睇咗唔同嘅星際迷航系列劇集。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: Those were drinking days, and most men drank hard. So very great is the improvement Time has brought about in such habits, that a moderate statement of the quantity of wine and punch which one man would swallow in the course of a night, without any detriment to his reputation as a perfect gentleman, would seem, in these days, a ridiculous exaggeration.

jyutping: go2 di1 hai6 jam2 zau2 ge3 jat6 zi2，ji4 daai6 bou6 fan6 naam4 jan4 dou1 jam2 dak1 hou2 ging6。si4 gaan3 deoi3 ni1 di1 zaap6 gwaan3 daai3 lai4 ge3 goi2 sin6 hai6 gam3 daai6，ji5 zi3 jyu1 jat1 go3 jan4 hai2 jat1 maan5 zi1 noi6 wui5 tan1 haa6 gei2 do1 zau2 tung4 kyun4 tau4，ji4 m4 wui5 syun2 hoi6 keoi5 zok3 wai4 jat1 go3 jyun4 mei5 ge3 gwan1 zi2 ge3 ming4 sing1，hai2 ni1 gei2 jat6，ci5 fu4 hai6 jat1 zung2 fong1 mau6 ge3 kwaa1 zoeng1。
text: 嗰啲係飲酒嘅日子，而大部分男人都飲得好勁。時間對呢啲習慣帶嚟嘅改善係咁大，以至於一個人喺一晚之內會吞下幾多酒同拳頭，而唔會損害佢作為一個完美嘅君子嘅名聲，喺呢幾日，似乎係一種荒謬嘅誇張。
